The '''Shipbuilders and Astromechs Guild''' designed many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and navigation systems for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Its leader in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] was [[Kooloota-Fyf]].
